hero.headline: Know what your evidence shows before the other side does.
hero.body: The story is rarely in one system. It is in the email, plus the text message, plus the GPS record, connected, tested, and explained by an expert who will stand behind the conclusion. That is Truth Through Data.

reassembly.headline: No single source told the story. Together they did.
reassembly.resultText: One sequence of events, on one clock, that held up on cross-examination.
reassembly.footnote: The order of events was never in any one system. It existed across five, in five formats, on five different clocks. Reassembling it, and explaining why that reassembly is sound, is the work.

storyBrand.eyebrow: What you get when you call
storyBrand.headline: You are the one who has to stand up and explain what happened. We make sure the evidence is ready when you do.
storyBrand.body: You carry the case, and your client carries the risk. When you call, we determine what the evidence shows, what it does not, and what it means for your strategy.

cards.label: The problem
cards.head: Access is not clarity.
cards.text: Having the data doesn’t mean you know what it shows.

cards.label: What is at stake
cards.head: Evidence only matters if people can understand it.
cards.text: Complex evidence that cannot be explained clearly can be misunderstood, discounted, or never used at all.

cards.label: The outcome
cards.head: Make the evidence clear, credible, and usable.
cards.text: From the first question through the final presentation, we help you understand what the evidence shows and communicate it with confidence.

plan.headline: Three steps to an answer you can use.

steps.title: Ask
steps.text: Bring us your question. Not a scope document: the thing you need to establish, and the deadline you are working against. On that first call, we will tell you whether we are the right firm for it.

steps.title: Know
steps.text: We find, preserve, and test the evidence, so you know what it shows, what it does not, and where uncertainty remains. One team manages it end to end.

steps.title: Act
steps.text: Build your strategy around what can actually be shown, and present it with confidence, with an expert ready to testify to the findings.

howWeHelp.headline: Three phases. Three questions.
howWeHelp.body: Every case has three phases. Every dispute begins with questions. The evidence helps answer them.
howWeHelp.body2: From discovery through damages, iDS brings together the people, technology, and expertise needed to find the evidence, understand what it shows, and explain what it means.

verticals.title: Discovery
verticals.tag: Secure the evidence. Find what’s missing. Fix it.
verticals.q: You cannot make your case with evidence you cannot find, access, or use.
verticals.text: We support forensic preservation, collection, processing, hosting, translation, and review across virtually every source and platform. We directly offer Relativity, RelAIR, and Nuix Discover. More importantly, this isn’t DIY: we can help you use them correctly and efficiently.
verticals.goal: Get the evidence into a form your legal team and experts can actually use, and the technical support for those tools.

verticals.title: Merits
verticals.q: Once you have the evidence, you need to know what it shows.
verticals.text: Our experts use digital forensics, structured data analysis, reconstruction, authentication, and subject-matter expertise to test competing accounts against the evidence and establish defensible findings.
verticals.goal: Establish the facts so the trier of fact can decide what they mean under the law.

verticals.title: Damages
verticals.q: Once you understand what happened, you need to show what it caused.
verticals.text: Our forensic accountants, economists, valuation professionals, and other experts analyze the financial and economic consequences: testing assumptions, measuring exposure, and evaluating alternative scenarios.
verticals.goal: Present a clear, supportable assessment of the consequences.

howWeHelp.foundationText: You do not need to know which technology, service, or expert discipline will answer the question before you call us. Bring us the case. We’ll help you gather the evidence, find what the evidence says, then testify to those findings.

statementBand.headline: The evidence is fragmented.
statementBand.body: Events unfolded in sequence, but the evidence of those events was scattered across devices, cloud services, applications, communications, and transactional systems, each capturing a different fragment, in a different format, and sometimes on a different clock. Bring those fragments together and a picture begins to emerge that no single source could reveal.
points: Triangulate across sources, not within one
One expert who can explain the assembly
statementBand.lead: The timeline already exists. But no single source recorded it.
statementBand.body2: That triangulation is both the challenge of digital evidence and its strength: the ability to test one source against another and reconstruct what actually happened.

canYou.headline: Questions clients bring us. Anonymized, but every one of them is real.
canYou.body: Our answer is yes, because we have done each of these. Some of them several times over. Select one to see how it was approached.
questions: Can you disprove commonality in a class action built on billions of records?
Can you authenticate evidence that everyone else has assumed is valid?
Can you locate decades-old policies buried in millions of archived documents?
Can you correlate mobile, cloud, and application data to reconstruct a timeline no one else can see?
Can you resolve a matter without relying on email as the primary evidence source?
canYou.ctaFinal: See how these questions get answered →

beyond.headline: Beyond eDiscovery
beyond.body1: We handle discovery, and we handle it well, in part because we rely on it ourselves. Our experts work on the evidence our own teams collect, process, and manage, which is exactly why the foundation has to be sound. But that is not why most clients call. They call because they need expert judgment on what the evidence means, and someone who will defend that judgment under oath.
beyond.body2: Technology enables the work. Expert reasoning governs the conclusions.
beyond.weAreText: a firm of experts who stand behind our work, and in front of our opinions
